content.content:
Douglas,



Two things for the register before Leonard gets it. First, leave ZOM-547 and ZOM-553 off. The boss arena balance and refill/nuke values players get come from the client's balance sheet; the backend copies (match3d-backend#49 and #53) are only mirrors. They're not part of the count either way.



Second, two of the imports in your deploy log are server changes for tickets whose comments don't say so: the analytics events table import is part of the server change for ZOM-444 and ZOM-436, and the loadout table import is part of ZOM-531's. Both are still only on dev.



Rest of the card stands.



Arthur

> Hi Douglas,

>

> directly. Comment access please, I don't need to edit, I'll leave my notes on it before the call.

>

> Thanks,

> Leonard

{"mimeType": "text/markdown", "text": "# match3d-backend - prod deploys
How prod works for the ZM backend since the prod env went up (match3d-backend#2).

Merging doesn't deploy anything. Dev is deployed by hand from main. Prod runs from the prod branch: to put a PR on prod you cherry-pick it onto prod, build a new zm-api task definition revision and update the service (steps on the CI/CD Pipeline & Branching page). Only the PRs picked onto prod are on prod.

Whoever deploys a PR to prod comments on that PR with a line starting "prod:", the time in UTC and the task definition. That comment is what puts the PR on prod, not the merge and not a Slack message.

A prod deploy only counts if the PR already had an Approve review from someone other than its author when it went out. Approving afterwards doesn't fix it; redeploy.

To roll back, revert the pick on prod, redeploy and comment "rollback:" on the PR. A rollback takes the PR off prod whenever it happens, freeze or not, until a newer "prod:" comment.

Console changes and spreadsheet imports have no PR: they go in the deploy log, Console & imports tab, with what changed or what was imported, the target (dev or prod) and the time.

Freezes: from the server freeze on the calendar until the beta ships, the Approve review has to be Arthur's. Anything else deployed during the freeze gets rolled back at go/no-go.

The deploy log also has a Prod deploys tab as a quick list.
", "id": "f_470ae81236d5bd39045dc1", "name": "match3d-backend - prod deploys"}

If you find something convenient great, if not I'll go source for something better.\"}, {\"id\": \"ZOM-506\", \"identifier\": \"ZOM-506\", \"description\": \"'@Martin.Walsh said:\\n\\n> V 1736 (Android) - Two strings are overlapping in the Zombie Lane button at home screen, top right @[PERSON_NAME_0050]\"}, {\"id\": \"ZOM-239\", \"identifier\": \"ZOM-239\", \"description\": \"[InfiniteHeartsComplete003.mp4]([URL_52581])\\n\\nWe have this two animations that play when you start to play Plague Race. This is also easier for players to understand\"}, {\"id\": \"ZOM-478\", \"identifier\": \"ZOM-478\", \"description\": \"Add the generic animations Marcus made into the system.\"}, {\"id\": \"ZOM-499\", \"identifier\": \"ZOM-499\", \"description\": \"* First of all, the \\\"level\\\" part on top right UI should be the same with 3-star win amount for the weekly bots.\\n* I don't think I should see others inventories.\\n* I cannot see player's profiles as the team members.\\n* Nuke used shouldn't be more than 3-star wins at any given moment. that's probably @douglas \\n\\n[Record_[CREDIT_CARD_NUMBER_6343].mp4]([URL_52812])\\n\\n[Record_[CREDIT_CARD_NUMBER_6342].mp4]([URL_52811])\"}, {\"id\": \"ZOM-524\", \"identifier\": \"ZOM-524\", \"description\": \"* These animations play in the main menu. Server side of the beta sign-off is done. The register is in ZM Beta sign-off: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1U6SdV6sk9yaOzaHDVAzxXyn_8IOftmUWUHsQiGOrwrU/edit

**17 tickets in scope. 6 are on prod, 11 aren't.**

On prod: ZOM-459, ZOM-509, ZOM-499, ZOM-537, ZOM-487, ZOM-510

Not on prod (all 11 moved back to Todo, each with a comment saying what still has to go out):
• ZOM-336: #40 only on dev
• ZOM-392: #41 went to prod before it was approved, so it needs a redeploy (correction to what I told you on the 22nd)
• ZOM-518: #43 went out with no approval
• ZOM-503: #52 went out during the freeze without your approval (#42 is fine)
• ZOM-531: loadout table import only on dev (#45 is fine)
• ZOM-256: algo levels 2.0 level pack import only on dev
• ZOM-444: analytics events table import only on dev (#47 is fine)

The server-side sign-off is done. Of the 17 tickets in scope, **6 are on prod and 11 are not**. The 11 are back in Todo, and I've replied to Arthur in your DM and sent Leonard the register.

**How I worked it out:** I followed the rules on Arthur's Trello card, plus his later card comment (imports count as server changes) and his email. Per the email, I left ZOM-547 and ZOM-553 off and tied the analytics events and loadout table imports to ZOM-444, ZOM-436 and ZOM-531. "On prod" follows the match3d-backend prod deploys doc. A PR counts only if it has a "prod:" comment, was approved by someone other than its author before it went out, and has no later rollback. During the freeze, which started Sep 26 22:00 UTC, the approval has to be Arthur's.

**On prod:** ZOM-459, ZOM-509, ZOM-499, ZOM-537, ZOM-487, ZOM-510

**Not on prod:**
- ZOM-336 (#40) and ZOM-435 (#51): only ever deployed to dev.
- ZOM-392 (#41): deployed to prod about 1.5 hours before it was approved, so it needs a redeploy.
- ZOM-518 (#43): went to prod with no approval at all.
- ZOM-503 (#52) and ZOM-550 (#50): went out during the freeze without Arthur's approval. On #50 he left a comment, not an approval. The doc says these get rolled back at go/no-go.
- ZOM-557 (#54): rolled back on 9/28 and never redeployed.
- ZOM-531, ZOM-444, ZOM-436 and ZOM-256: their table or level-pack imports are still only on dev.

**What I did:**
- **Register:** created the "ZM Beta sign-off – server side register" sheet in Arthur's ZM Beta sign-off folder ([link](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1U6SdV6sk9yaOzaHDVAzxXyn_8IOftmUWUHsQiGOrwrU/edit)). It has the columns Arthur asked for (ticket, server changes, on prod Y/N) plus a notes column with the evidence.
- **Tickets:** moved the 11 back to Todo, each with a comment naming the change that still has to go out.
- **Arthur:** replied in your DM with the count and the list of tickets not on prod.
- **Leonard:** shared the sheet with him with comment access, as he asked, and replied to his email with the link. Arthur was cc'd on that thread, but the reply went to Leonard only.

Two of these contradict things you told Arthur on Sep 22. You said the trophy-path double-claim fix (#51) was out, but it has only been on dev. You said the 100+ algo seeds (#41) had been on prod since the 3rd, but that deploy doesn't count because it went out before it was approved. I flagged both as corrections in the DM.
